fact: The BCRG is recruiting consultants to draw up a 2027-2030 national payments systems strategy, with proposals of reforms to the legal and regulatory framework and oversight of payment systems, after a diagnostic found no formal national strategy (applications due 31 August 2026).
title: Termes de référence - Stratégie Nationale des Systèmes et Moyens de Paiement (SNSMP) 2027-2030
publisher: Banque Centrale de la République de Guinée, Direction des Systèmes et Moyens de Paiement
